item.title: Texture Utility Tool
item.description:
Tags: Scripted Tool, Texturing, Batch, Optimisation
Software: Python
Project Total Time: 3 weeks

The Problem

Working as a freelancer and lecturer, I’ve found artists are constantly needing to work with a large volume of PBR textures or image files at a time which can waste a lot of time doing repetitive tasks to fix these files. Frequently artits need to change the scale, converting the file type, pack channels, converting normals/ao and create atlases to save on space. This tool can do all those operations and even convert key files such as normal maps and channel packs from Unreal Engine to Unity formats natively.

item.title: Sky Island Generator
item.description:
Tags: Procedural Mesh
Software: Houdini, Unreal Engine Project Total Time: 2 weeks

The Problem

When working on my latest seasonal shaders, I found it difficult to display how they worked without stress testing them on a variety of topology. Using Legend of Zelda; Tears of the Kingdom as my greatest inspiration, I took to making a sky island generator that can easily procedurally create a variety of islands quickly with seed values.

item.title: Shader Musuem
item.description:
Tags: Shaders, Seasonal Effects
Software: Unreal Engine
Project Total Time: 2 weeks

The Problem

For teaching purposes I needed to create a level where a bunch of easy to adjust shaders could be found for students to experiment with, primarily for enviroment artists. This evolved into a “museum” space for easier display and walkthrough using game view.

How I Made It

I used Unreal Engines shader node network to build out each shader from various master materials. I went with the winter theme as snow, ice and moss had good masking effects that could be reused on other materials. Ice also posed a complex challenge on how to present more costly and accurate solutions versus a simpler cheaper one. Whilst satisfied I definitely want to redo this project to a much higher standard as blending is very sharp amongst a lot of my noise effects. I also want to dabble more in HLSL to see how I can reduce the amount of repetitive data being called from noises and operations in the graph making it very noisy. Checkout my Development Blog Post

item.title: Batch Mesh Renamer
item.description:
Return to Maxscript 2025 Megapost Grab the tool here

The Problem and What It Solves

Ever had to rename your LODS, add prefixes or suffixes for baking or fix exports for Unreal Engine? Download the script from my repo, then simply select the meshes you want to rename, apply or remove the chosen prefix/suffix to the meshes. You can fully edit the text for prefix and suffix to fit your project needs and naming conventions. ​

item.title: Mesh Aligner
item.description:
Return to Maxscript 2025 Megapost Grab the tool here

The Problem and What It Solves

Unsure of how to find ngons, stray vertices and other face issues prior to export? Simply drag and drop this script in and use the check icons to scan meshes. It supports checking for ngons, floating vertices and overlapping vertices, all issues that could cause mesh problems later on. Using the select icon, you can preview problem areas on the mesh.

item.title: Mesh Pivot Setter
item.description:
Return to Maxscript 2025 Megapost Grab the tool here

The Problem and What It Solves

Stuck setting the pivots on your meshes for modular meshes, bulk or simply want to reset all to ground using each meshes complex shape? Drag and drop this script in for an easy way to set pivots in 3DSMax. This tool supports setting pivots using mesh bounds, transferring pivots from A to B or setting them using global scene coordinates.

item.title: Tree Generator
item.description:
Return to Maxscript 2025 Megapost Grab the tool here

The Problem and What It Solves

This was a fun challenge to end off Maxscript May 2025 to create an all in one tree builder using just Maxscript. The final results are in Unreal Engine with a custom leaf and trunk shader. In future terms its not quick to run and kind of cumbersome I would definitely redo this in another software like Houdini.
